topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the course structure, core themes, and intended learning outcomes for the cancer biology series.

topics.label: Biological basis and cellular modeling of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer arises from stepwise genetic and epigenetic changes that disrupt normal cellular differentiation and tissue architecture, and consider how this is modeled in culture.

topics.label: Mechanisms, histology, and progression of invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how benign precursor lesions evolve into invasive and metastatic malignancies through histological, anatomical, and stepwise progression mechanisms.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature, classification, and clinical pathophysiology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the naming conventions for different tumor types and the physical and systemic mechanisms through which both benign and malignant growths cause patient morbidity and mortality.

topics.label: Cancer incidence and comparative oncology across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore tumor incidence patterns in humans and compare cancer susceptibility and development across diverse animal species and multicellular taxa.

topics.label: Clinical symptoms and cancer screening strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate early clinical presentations of tumors and compare the methods, histological principles, and efficacy of screening programs across different cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture closing and housekeeping
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a reminder of the learning outcomes and housekeeping details for upcoming sessions.
